goal: Build inventory.py as described in SPEC.md.
context: Python 3 stdlib only (sqlite3, threading). One module inventory.py in the repo root.

tasks.title: Schema versions 1..3, PRAGMA user_version, in-place migration, SchemaError for newer databases

argv:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from inventory import *
import sqlite3,tempfile,os
p=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'v1.db'); c=sqlite3.connect(p)
c.execute("CREATE TABLE products(sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(price_cents >= 0), stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(stock >= 0))")
c.execute("CREATE TABLE movements(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, sku TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(sku), delta INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, ref TEXT, ts TEXT NOT NULL)")
c.execute("INSERT INTO products VALUES ('A','Apple',100,7)"); c.execute('PRAGMA user_version = 1'); c.commit(); c.close()
i=Inventory(p); print(i.schema_version(), i.get_product('A').stock, i.get_product('A').reorder_level)
